subject: Invoice delivery channel & billing owner — fallback policy needed
messages:
From: Evelyn Beauregard <ap@starlight.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Invoicing preferences + PO (EIN split across entities)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last week. AP here — we have a couple of housekeeping items before your invoices start. Can you confirm the preferred delivery mechanism for invoices for Starlight? We have two legal entities in scope for this PO: Starlight AI Ltd (GB) and Starlight AI NL BV. Our AP team would prefer:

- Primary delivery: secure vendor portal (SFTP or portal push)
- Email copies to ap@starlight.ai for manual routing to subsidiaries
- Separate VAT tags on PDFs (we need country & VAT number visible)

Attached is PO_5871.pdf and a short billing matrix showing the two remit-to entities. If portal is an option, can you provide the SFTP endpoint or portal enrollment link and a point of contact to set up the collector mapping?

Also: we need invoice XML schema for our ERP import — if you support an XML push (or webhook), include sample schema or a contact to enable.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Beauregard
Accounts Payable, Starlight AI
ap@starlight.ai
+44 20 5555 1212

--
Attachment: PO_5871.pdf (PDF, 138KB)
Attachment: starlight-billing-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Beauregard <ap@starlight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoicing preferences + PO (EIN split across entities)

Hi Evelyn — good to hear from you and thanks for the PO + matrix.

Short answers up front:
- We support both portal push (preferred) and email delivery.
- We can send both a consolidated PDF and per-entity PDF with VAT tags.
- We offer an XML invoice export (OAGIS-lite) via secured webhook or SFTP drop; sample schema attached here.

Proposed handoff plan:
1) We set up your AP team as a recipient in our portal (portal URL below). Portal will be primary — we can auto-push invoices per-entity to separate folders or SFTP prefixes.
2) Email copies (ap@starlight.ai) will be sent as blind copy for manual processing.
3) If your ERP prefers XML ingestion, Ben will coordinate the webhook/SFTP technical setup and verify sample payloads.

Action items: can you confirm which VAT numbers map to each entity in the matrix (I see two columns but want explicit country tags)? Also confirm if your finance team needs PDF+XML or XML-only for automated import.

Portal enrollment link: https://portal.redwood.com/enroll/starlight-dl5249 (expires in 7 days)
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks — I’ve looped in Marissa (billing ops) and Ben (integrations) to make the handoff smooth.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

--
Attachment: redwood-invoice-xml-sample.xml (XML, 6KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: FW: Invoicing preferences + PO (EIN split across entities)

Ben — forwarding Starlight's request. Summary of what they need:
- Portal enrollment + SFTP prefix per legal entity
- PDF must show VAT/Company number on each per-entity invoice
- Provide XML sample and confirm webhook vs SFTP options
- Email ap@starlight.ai should still receive BCC copies

Can you:
1) Confirm we can create two SFTP prefixes: /starlight/GB/ and /starlight/NL/?
2) Confirm filename convention for per-entity invoices (we normally use INVOICE_<COMPANY>_<YYYYMMDD>_<INVC-ID>.pdf and matching XML).
3) Share expected SLA for portal push failures and fallback to email (suggest 4 hours then email fallback).

I’ll provision the portal enrollment and send creds to their AP contact after you confirm SFTP details.

Marissa
Billing Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@starlight.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoicing preferences + PO (EIN split across entities)

Thanks — this plan looks good. Quick answers:
- VAT mapping confirmed in attached updated matrix (we appended the country tags and VAT numbers).
- We want both PDF+XML files pushed to SFTP prefixes. Our ERP team will pick up XML and archive PDFs.
- Agree on fallback: 4 hours to portal push; if we see a failure, please send email copy to ap@starlight.ai and cc finance@starlight.ai.

One operational ask: for any invoices where the XML payload returns a validation error on our side, can you include a short machine-readable 'error_code' field in the push response so our ingestion pipeline can mark and retry?

We’re happy to proceed with portal enrollment. Please send the enrollment link and credentials and we’ll onboard the AP users this week.

Oliver Grant
Head of Finance, Starlight AI
oliver.grant@starlight.ai
